page.overview:
Who is Celebrindor?

Celebrindor was the fifth King of Arthedain.

Celebrindor was the son of King Celepharn of Arthedain. He came to the throne in TA 1191 at the death of his father. During Celebrindor's rule over Arthedain, there was intermittent skirmishing with Cardolan and Rhudaur, but no major events of note. Celebrindor died in TA 1272 after ruling for eighty-one years and was succeeded by his son Malvegil.

The name Celebrindor is Sindarin; likely meaning 'silver lord' or 'silver-like lord'.

As outlined in The Peoples of Middle-earth: The Heirs of Elendil, Celebrindor was first written as Celemenegil and Celebrindol but was corrected and changed to Celebrindor.
